title: Catalina as a UFO hotspot
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Catalina as a UFO hotspot, about unspecified at Santa Catalina Island, California, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: It was for Catalina, which is one of... it's on the coast of Southern California, and many people think it's a UFO hotspot.
[clears throat] And then uh and then Southern California seems to be the Catalina Channel seems to be a hot spot.
tellings.difference: Gallaudet names the Catalina Channel itself and makes it part of his ocean-hotspot argument, with no credit to Preston Dennett.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the waters around Catalina off Southern California as a UFO hotspot.

as_told.title: Catalina Channel as a UAP hotspot
